name: Roper Jessa
title: The Ropewalk
examine: She walks twelve miles a day without leaving one room. Her lines hold boats, bells, and one very specific promise.
lines: A rope is a hundred small holds agreeing to be one long one. So is a town.
Walk with me if you want to talk. The strand doesn't lay itself.
Anything that snaps was two flaws and a hurry. I sell neither.
